items.title: Pendulum dynamics
items.description: Interactive simulation exploring simple and chaotic pendulum motion. Students can adjust initial conditions and observe how small changes lead to dramatically different trajectories in phase space.

items.title: Wave interference
items.description: Visualize constructive and destructive interference patterns. Adjust wave parameters to understand how superposition creates complex patterns from simple harmonic motion.

items.title: Fourier series visualization
items.description: Build complex periodic functions from simple sine and cosine waves. See how mathematical decomposition reveals the harmonic structure underlying any periodic signal.

items.title: Orbital mechanics
items.description: Explore gravitational dynamics and orbital motion. Adjust masses, velocities, and positions to understand how celestial bodies interact through gravitational forces.

items.title: Statistical distributions
items.description: Interactive exploration of probability distributions and the central limit theorem. Generate random samples and observe how distributions emerge from randomness.

items.title: Complex function mapping
items.description: Visualize how complex functions transform the complex plane. See conformal mappings and understand how analytic functions preserve angles while distorting distances.
